principles: Hard constraints are evaluated before compatibility scoring.
Exceeding a minimum requirement is never penalized.
Preferences use proximity; skills use minimum-requirement satisfaction.
Personality and reasoning can never exclude a business by themselves.
Business requirement values are configurable editorial heuristics, not probabilities of success.

budget.rule: If user budget is below business minimum, apply a ratio penalty; never penalize budget above minimum.

time.rule: If user weekly hours are below the model minimum, apply a ratio penalty.

required_skills.rule: If a hard skill is missing and the user explicitly refuses to learn it, apply a severe penalty or exclude.

match_functions.threshold_requirement: min(100, user_value / required_value * 100), with 100 when required_value is 0
match_functions.advantage_overlap: weighted overlap across industries, languages, network and prior experience
match_functions.personality: low-weight target proximity only; no hard filters
match_functions.reasoning: relevance-weighted bonus only; no hard filters
